name: BioGRID ORCS (Open Repository of CRISPR Screens)
scope: Curated CRISPR screen results from 418 publications (home page); human screens bundled in BIOGRID-ORCS-ALL-homo_sapiens-LATEST.screens.tar.gz.

quantitative.summary: Per-screen scores and hit calls, protocol-dependent.

licence.name: MIT License (stated on the BioGRID download repository page for BioGRID-ORCS; data provided without warranty)
licence.redistribution: Free for academic and commercial use under the MIT License; cite the original contributing authors and Stark et al. 2006 (Nucleic Acids Res 34:D535). This repository does not redistribute the archive.

coverage_limitations: Screen design, cell line and readout vary widely; hits are not directly comparable
known_omissions: Variant-level perturbation (base editing) screens are not its focus

reuse_decision.rationale: Open Targets lists evidence_crispr/evidence_crispr_screen, but its source mix is not verified to equal ORCS; fetch the human bundle for gene-level screen detail.
